# Mosquito Ninja

Mosquito Ninja is an owner-operated mosquito and tick control service for South Jersey residential, commercial, municipal and government-managed outdoor properties.

Primary phone: 609-313-6317
Primary email: service@njbugninja.com
Website: https://njbugninja.com/

## Services

Mosquito control focuses on outdoor resting and harborage areas relevant to the property, such as dense foliage, shaded edges, damp areas and conditions around standing water.

Tick control focuses on habitat such as wooded edges, leaf litter, low brush, stone walls and transition zones used by people and pets.

Commercial and government service is available for outdoor business, hospitality, municipal and government-managed properties, subject to route and scheduling availability. Relevant property types include restaurant patios, outdoor dining areas, event venues, courtyards, landscaped common areas and municipal outdoor sites.

## Service area

Core launch routes currently cover Burlington County, Camden County and Gloucester County in New Jersey.

Atlantic County, Cumberland County and Salem County require route and scheduling confirmation before service is accepted.

Cape May County and Ocean County are outside the normal service area at this time.

Property-specific route coverage and scheduling should always be confirmed directly with Mosquito Ninja.

## Business model and contact

Mosquito Ninja is owner-operated. The property discussion, quote and service remain with one point of contact.

Customers can request a quote through the website, call or text 609-313-6317, or email service@njbugninja.com.

## Important service information

Mosquito Ninja does not promise complete elimination of mosquitoes or ticks. Outdoor pest pressure varies with weather, habitat and neighboring properties. Customers receive product-specific re-entry instructions for their visit. Timing and service frequency depend on the property, pest activity, weather and the treatment used.
